input.summary: Give Company a 30-day convenience right during SOWs; lengthen Contractor's convenience notice to 90 days
input.comment: [Playbook] As drafted neither party may terminate for convenience while a Statement of Work is open, so we have added our standard 30-day convenience right (with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees) and moved Contractor's convenience notice to 90 days. We can live with 60 days' notice for Company if needed.

ops.oldText: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
ops.newText: (a) Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, Contractor may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon ninety (90) days advance notice to Company.

input.summary: Replace Arizona law with New York law and New York County courts
input.comment: [Playbook] Arizona is outside our accepted list, so we have moved governing law and venue to New York; Delaware, California or England and Wales are acceptable alternatives.

ops.oldText: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
ops.newText: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement.
